newsitem.title: FRANCE: Little price effect seen from dlr rise-BoF survey.
newsitem.headline: Little price effect seen from dlr rise-BoF survey.

text.p: Prices of commodities and finished goods were seen to be little changed overall in June, though some increases in the cost of supplies were seen in some semi-finished goods sectors due to the rise in the dollar, the Bank of France said in its June survey of industry.
These increases were not passed on in terms of higher sales prices, it said in a statement.
"Prices of commodities and finished products did not change much overall," the Bank said in a statement on its survey.
"Some increases in the cost of supplies were seen in some semi-finished goods sectors, caused mainly by the rise in the dollar. These were not passed on into sale prices," it said.
